mode.description: Operation mode: C (Consumer), P (Producer), L (List metadata)

partition.description: Partition ID (-1 for all, or specific integer)

security_props.description: List of Kafka client security properties to pass via -X arguments. Each item is a flat object with 'name' and 'value'. Example: [{'name': 'sasl.mechanisms', 'value': 'PLAIN'}]
